description: Convert a color between formats. Input accepts a hex, CSS name, RNV brand name, or saved-palette reference. With `to` set to one of hex/rgb/hsv/hsl/lab, returns just that format; otherwise returns all of them. Read-only and deterministic, with no side effects. Use for format conversion of a single color; to blend several colors into one use mix_colors, and to compare two colors use color_difference.
name: convert_color
